blocks.content: A mute timing defines recurring time intervals during which notifications are suppressed. Unlike silences (one-time, label-matched), mute timings repeat on a schedule and are attached to notification policies.
To create a time interval, complete the following steps:
In Grafana Cloud, navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Contact points**, then select the **Mute timings** tab.
Select the **Mute timings** tab at the top of the page.
Click **Add mute timing** to create a new recurring suppression window.
Enter a **Name** for the mute timing. Choose a descriptive name such as `Weekend quiet hours` or `Maintenance window`.

Configure the **Time interval** fields:

| Field | Example | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| **Days of the week** | `saturday`, `sunday` | Which days to mute |
| **Times** | `00:00 - 08:00` | Time range (UTC) to mute |
| **Months** | (leave empty) | Restrict to specific months |
| **Days of the month** | (leave empty) | Restrict to specific dates |
| **Years** | (leave empty) | Restrict to specific years |

For a weekend suppression example:
- Days of the week: `saturday` to `sunday`
- Times: leave empty to mute all day

For overnight quiet hours:
- Times: `22:00` to `06:00`
- Days of the week: leave empty for every night
Click **Submit** to save the mute timing.
In the next milestone, you'll attach this mute timing to a notification policy.
